title: SLO granularity, proactive load-gating & telemetry buildout
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Instrument and expose a set of fine-grained SLIs and golden signals that enable proactive load-gating and smarter circuit decisions across regions. Deliver a dashboard bundle and a lightweight runbook so oncall and SRE can triage sequence-aware admission issues and KV-prefetch regressions without full-playback. This work ties together admit-score smoothing, sequence-length cohorting, KV prewarm indicators, and a new `load_gating` event stream for debugging shed decisions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Token-level p50/p95/p99 latency SLIs aggregated by sequence-length cohort are available for all active regions
2) Admit-score smoothing and recent admit-rate hysteresis metrics surfaced as timeseries and event logs
3) KV-prefetch hit/miss counters and prewarm success rate visible per model+shard
4) New load_gating event stream emitted for each admission decision and linked to trace IDs
5) Dashboard pack (overview + per-region + per-model cohort panels) shipped to Grafana and linked in the runbook
6) Playbook with step-by-step triage and rollback guidance published in Confluence
7) End-to-end smoke test validates event emission, SLI calculation, and dashboard rendering in staging
tasks: Design SLI definitions and cohorting buckets (sequence length, priority, model family)
Add instrumentation: admit-score, admit-smoothing, kv-prefetch, load_gating events
Extend telemetry pipeline to tag events with region, shard, and trace_id
Implement SLI rollups and alert rules (p95 > threshold per cohort)
Build Grafana dashboard panels and templated variables (region, model, shard, cohort)
Author Confluence runbook + playbook and link dashboards/PRs
Create smoke test harness and CI check for telemetry schema
comments: 2026-03-01 Maya Chen: Created ticket after postmortem for INC-2026-119; initial scoping done with SRE. Targeting runtime-1.22 for rollout.
2026-03-03 Liam O'Connor: Spike complete. Prototype emits load_gating events from admit-controller. Observability pipeline needs an additional 'cohort' tag to avoid cardinality explosion.
2026-03-05 Priya Rao (SRE): Reviewed SLI definitions; requested p99 be calculated using reservoir sampling for high-cardinality routes. Also flagged alert noise risk for low-traffic cohorts.
2026-03-07 Liam O'Connor: Instrumentation PR opened (runtime#2345). Added instrumentation behind feature flag 'observability:load_gating_v1'. KV prewarm metrics emitted from cache-warmup worker.
2026-03-08 Design review (Ava Martinez): Dashboard wireframes look good; suggested adding a compact 'decision trace' panel that links admit decisions to a sequence timeline.
2026-03-09 Maya Chen: Integrated reservation: set sampling rules for low-traffic cohorts and added suppression windows to alert rules. Planning staging rollout Thursday.

2026-03-10 SRE rotation test (Priya): Basic smoke passed. One follow-up: load_gating events occasionally missing trace_id when requests time out before tracing header propagation. Added new task to propagate tracing header earlier.
decision_log: Adopted cohorting by sequence-length buckets (0-64, 65-256, 257-1024, >1024) to balance signal usefulness and cardinality.

Use event-based load_gating stream instead of continuously exporting every admission decision to reduce ingestion costs; events include reason, admit_score, prior_smoothing, region, model, shard, and trace_id.
Implement p99 SLI using distributed reservoir sampling at ingestion to avoid heavy storage costs while retaining tail fidelity.
Default alerts to region-level p95 breaches; only escalate to global pager if 3+ regions breach simultaneously or if customer-impact label high.
Feature-flag the instrumentation for gradual rollout and canary on dedicated clusters before enabling in hosted.
Add KV prewarm success rate metric and tie to autoscaler warmup window tuning as an optimizing signal for future work.
notes: Trade-offs: finer cohorting improves diagnostic speed but increases cardinality and alert noise. To mitigate, we sample low-volume cohorts and create synthetic aggregate cohorts for alerting.
Related work: ties to ENG-614223 (sli-sentinel) and ENG-210007 (sequenced-sli-prober). Coordinate release windows.
Potential follow-ups: automated remediation that temporarily widens admit-score hysteresis during infra noisiness, and a UI to replay load_gating streams for incident rehearsal.
Oncall guidance summary: check 'decision trace' panel, inspect admit_score trend, validate KV prewarm rate, and check sampling markers before escalating.
Estimated rollout plan: small canary -> 48h observation -> widen canary -> 7-day burn-in -> global enable.
